title: Andavan Kattalai
desc: An honest man tries to bring down the atrocities of corrupt people. Circumstances make him fall in love with an evil politician's daughter.

title: Naai Sekar Returns
desc: Naai Sekar, a small-time criminal, earns his living by kidnapping dogs belonging to wealthy people. However, his life takes an unexpected turn when Naai accidentally captures a wicked gangster's dog.

title: Kutty
desc: When Kutty falls for Geeta, he decides to confess his feelings but is left heartbroken to discover her relationship with her classmate Arjun.

title: Kathakali
desc: Amudhavel, a simpleton, gets embroiled in the murder of Thamba, a local gangster. The police think that he is the culprit as he had a conflict with him in the past.

title: Raja Vamsam
desc: While working on a significant project for his company, a young man visits his hometown to meet his future wife and see his family. However, he discovers that she actually loves his relative.
